fact: FIJ reports that a birth record on the NPC's VitalReg digital birth registration portal was found registered under a Lagos man's National Identification Number (NIN), linking birth records to the NIN.

UNICEF's Denis Onoise said health-facility interoperability between birth registration and the national identity system had stalled, with none of 371 targeted facilities live at the time of the assessment, while NPC and NIMC propose that NIMC link registered births to the identity database and assign the NIN.
system: health-facility interoperability of birth registration with the NIN system

fact: The NPC says it now generates a NIN for each child at birth registration and synchronises birth registration data with NIMC's NIN records.
The NPC release says NPC, the Health Ministry, NIMC and Barnksforte Technologies have an initiative to issue a national identification number to every child at birth, starting in 2024.
